_comment: PROJECTS_FILE — the registry of Compose projects this instance may control.
Copy to projects.json and edit. Every key is a Compose project name, which
must match the project the stack actually runs under (`docker compose ls`, or
the `name:` field at the top of its compose file).
A project NOT listed here is still visible in the API if it's running on the
host, but can never be started or stopped through it. That asymmetry is the
point: a public endpoint should not be able to touch an arbitrary stack.
Keys starting with an underscore are ignored, so this comment is legal JSON.
compose_file        Path INSIDE this container (see the /stacks mount).
No compose_file means the project is read-only.
guest_controllable  Unauthenticated visitors may start/stop it. Everything
else needs the CONTROL_TOKEN.
always_on           Never leased, never auto-stopped, never guest-startable.
default_ttl_minutes How long a guest's lease lasts. The 60-minute default is
the backstop the whole guest-start feature rests on.
max_ttl_minutes     Ceiling on what a caller may request.
ready_container     Whose health decides 'the demo is actually usable'.
Without it, every container must be running.
demo_url            Where the dashboard sends a visitor once it's ready.
PREREQUISITE, easy to miss: the compose file must run from PREBUILT images.
This never builds anything — there's no build toolchain in the image and the
socket proxy sets BUILD=0 — so a compose file using `build:` will fail at
`up`. Use each project's deploy/ compose file (pulling from GHCR), not the
repo-root one most of them use for local development.

flight-tracker.description: Live aircraft positions over the Baltic, polled from OpenSky and replayed on a vector map.

_dinner-planner-not-yet: Left commented out (leading underscore) deliberately: dinner-planner has no
deploy/ compose file yet, and its root one uses `build:`, which cannot work
here — see the PREREQUISITE note above. Once it publishes images to GHCR and
gains a deploy/docker-compose.yml, rename this key to "dinner-planner" and
replace this array with the object below.
